import os,re,json
def load():
    d=os.path.normpath(os.environ['RLM_SESSION_DIR'])
    t=open(d+'/../../sessions/'+os.path.basename(d)+'.jsonl').read().replace('\\n','\n'); G={}
    for m in re.finditer(r'(Demo pair \d+ (?:input|output)|Test input) \((\d+)x(\d+)\):\n',t):
        k,h,w=m[1],int(m[2]),int(m[3])
        rows=[r.split() for r in t[m.end():].split('\n')[:h]]
        if k not in G and all(len(r)==w and all(x.isdigit() for x in r) for r in rows):
            G[k]=[[int(x) for x in r] for r in rows]
    return G
G=load()

def f(g):
    H,W=len(g),len(g[0]); bg=g[0][0]
    sep=None; axis=None
    for c in range(W):
        if sum(1 for r in range(H) if g[r][c]==2)>=H-1: sep=c; axis='v'; break
    if sep is None:
        for r in range(H):
            if sum(1 for c in range(W) if g[r][c]==2)>=W-1: sep=r; axis='h'; break
    cells=[(r,c,g[r][c]) for r in range(H) for c in range(W)
           if g[r][c]!=bg and g[r][c]!=2 and (axis=='v' or r!=sep) and (axis=='h' or c!=sep)]
    out=[[g[r][c] for c in range(W)] for r in range(H)]
    if axis=='v':
        cs=[c for r,c,_ in cells]; lo,hi=min(cs),max(cs)
        if lo>sep:                     # right of sep: slide LEFT to touch sep+1
            sh=(sep+1)-lo               # near edge = lo
            far=hi+sh                   # far side from sep = rightmost
            c8=far+1                    # line just beyond far side
        else:                          # left of sep: slide RIGHT to touch sep-1
            sh=(sep-1)-hi               # near edge = hi
            far=lo+sh
            c8=far-1
        for r in range(H):
            for c in range(lo,hi+1):
                if g[r][c]!=bg: out[r][c]=bg
        for r,c,v in cells: out[r][c+sh]=v
        for r in range(H): out[r][c8]=8
    else:   # axis h: separator ROW; shape slides UP/DOWN along rows
        rs=[r for r,c,_ in cells]; lo,hi=min(rs),max(rs)
        if lo>sep:                      # below sep: slide UP to touch sep+1
            vr=(sep+1)-hi
            far=lo+vr                   # far side = topmost (away from sep below)
            r8=far-1
        else:                           # above sep: slide DOWN to touch sep-1
            vr=(sep-1)-lo
            far=hi+vr
            r8=far+1
        for r in range(lo,hi+1):
            for c in range(W):
                if g[r][c]!=bg: out[r][c]=bg
        for r,c,v in cells: out[r+vr][c]=v
        for c in range(W): out[r8][c]=8
    return out

print('demo1', f(G['Demo pair 1 input'])==G['Demo pair 1 output'])
print('demo2', f(G['Demo pair 2 input'])==G['Demo pair 2 output'])
res=f(G['Test input'])
for r in res: print(' '.join(map(str,r)))
print(json.dumps(res))

def f(g):
    h=len(g); w=len(g[0]); bg=g[0][0]
    # find separator: a full line of one non-bg color
    idx=None; horiz=None; sepv=None
    for r in range(h):
        if len(set(g[r]))==1 and g[r][0]!=bg: idx=r; horiz=True; sepv=g[r][0]; break
    if idx is None:
        for c in range(w):
            if all(g[r][c]==g[0][c] for r in range(h)) and len({g[r][c] for r in range(h)})==1 and g[0][c]!=bg:
                idx=c; horiz=False; sepv=g[0][c]; break
    cells=[(r,c) for r in range(h) for c in range(w) if g[r][c]!=bg and g[r][c]!=sepv]
    out=[row[:] for row in g]
    if horiz:   # sep is a row; shape moves vertically toward it
        rs=[r for r,c in cells]
        above = max(rs)<idx          # shape entirely above separator
        near  = max(rs) if above else min(rs)
        tgt   = idx-1 if not above else idx+1
        d     = tgt-near
        for r,c in cells:
            out[r][c]=bg
        for r,c in cells:
            out[r+d][c]=g[r][c]
        fr = (max(rs)+d if not above else min(rs)+d) + 1   # far extreme after shift, away from sep
        for c in range(w): out[fr][c]=8
    else:       # sep is a column; shape moves horizontally toward it
        cs=[c for r,c in cells]
        right = max(cs)>idx
        near  = min(cs) if right else max(cs)
        tgt   = idx+1 if right else idx-1
        d     = tgt-near
        for r,c in cells:
            out[r][c]=bg
        for r,c in cells:
            out[r][c+d]=g[r][c]
        fc = (max(cs)+d if right else min(cs)+d) + 1
        for r in range(h): out[r][fc]=8
    return out

def f(g):
    h=len(g); w=len(g[0]); bg=g[0][0]
    hr=[r for r in range(h) if len(set(g[r]))==1 and g[r][0]!=bg]
    vc=[c for c in range(w) if len({g[r][c] for r in range(h)})==1 and g[0][c]!=bg]
    cells=[(r,c,g[r][c]) for r in range(h) for c in range(w) if g[r][c]!=bg and (hr or g[r][c]!=g[0][vc[0]] if vc else False)]
    # simpler: cells are anything non-bg that is not the separator color
    if hr:
        sv=g[hr[0]][0]; sepset={sv}
    else:
        sv=g[0][vc[0]]; sepset={sv}
    cells=[(r,c,v) for r in range(h) for c in range(w) if g[r][c]!=bg and v!=sv]
    out=[[bg]*w for _ in range(h)]
    if hr:
        idx=hr[0]
        rs=[r for r,c,v in cells]
        above=all(r<idx for r,c,v in cells)
        near=max(rs) if above else min(rs)
        tgt=idx-1 if above else idx+1
        d=tgt-near
        for r,c,v in cells: out[r+d][c]=v
        # 8-line adjacent on side away from sep
        far=max(rs+d) if above else min(rs+d)
        for c in range(w): out[far-1 if above else far+1][c]=8
    else:
        idx=vc[0]
        cs=[c for r,c,v in cells]
        left=all(c<idx for r,c,v in cells)
        near=min(cs) if left else max(cs)
        tgt=idx-1 if left else idx+1
        d=tgt-near
        for r,c,v in cells: out[r][c+d]=v
        fc=min(cs+d) if left else max(cs+d)
        for r in range(h): out[r][fc-1 if left else fc+1]=8
    return out

def f(g):
    h=len(g); w=len(g[0]); bg=g[0][0]
    sr=[r for r in range(h) if all(x==g[r][0] for x in g[r]) and g[r][0]!=bg]
    sc=[c for c in range(w) if all(g[r][c]==g[0][c] for r in range(h)) and g[0][c]!=bg]
    sepcolor=(g[sr[0]][0] if sr else g[0][sc[0]])
    cells=[(r,c,g[r][c]) for r in range(h) for c in range(w) if g[r][c]!=bg and g[r][c]!=sepcolor]
    out=[[bg]*w for _ in range(h)]
    if sr:  # horizontal separator
        idx=sr[0]
        rs=[r for r,c,v in cells]
        above = max(rs)<idx      # shape strictly above separator
        near = max(rs) if above else min(rs)
        tgt = idx+1 if above else idx-1   # near row becomes adjacent to separator
        d = tgt-near
        for r,c,v in cells: out[r+d][c]=v
        far = max(rs)+d if above else min(rs)+d
        r8 = far-1 if above else far+1
        for c in range(w): out[r8][c]=8
    else:   # vertical separator
        idx=sc[0]
        cs=[c for r,c,v in cells]
        left = max(cs)<idx
        near = min(cs) if left else max(cs)
        tgt = idx-1 if left else idx+1
        d = tgt-near
        for r,c,v in cells: out[r][c+d]=v
        fc = min(cs)+d if left else max(cs)+d
        for r in range(h): out[r][fc-1 if left else fc+1]=8
    return out

import json
def f(g):
    h=len(g); w=len(g[0]); bg=g[0][0]
    sr=[r for r in range(h) if len(set(g[r]))==1 and g[r][0]!=bg]
    sc=[c for c in range(w) if len({g[r][c] for r in range(h)})==1 and g[0][c]!=bg]
    sepv = g[sr[0]][0] if sr else g[0][sc[0]]
    cells=[(r,c,g[r][c]) for r in range(h) for c in range(w) if g[r][c]!=bg and g[r][c]!=sepv]
    out=[[bg]*w for _ in range(h)]
    if sr:
        idx=sr[0]
        rs=[r for r,c,v in cells]
        above = max(rs)<idx
        near = max(rs) if above else min(rs)
        tgt = idx+1 if above else idx-1
        d = tgt-near
        for r,c,v in cells: out[r+d][c]=v
        far = max(rs)+d if above else min(rs)+d
        r8 = far-1 if above else far+1
        for c in range(w): out[r8][c]=8
    else:
        idx=sc[0]
        cs=[c for r,c,v in cells]
        left = max(cs)<idx
        near = min(cs) if left else max(cs)
        tgt = idx-1 if left else idx+1
        d = tgt-near
        for r,c,v in cells: out[r][c+d]=v
        fc = min(cs)+d if left else max(cs)+d

import json
def f(g):
    h=len(g); w=len(g[0]); bg=g[0][0]
    # find separator: full monochromatic line whose color differs from background
    sr=[r for r in range(h) if len(set(g[r]))==1 and g[r][0]!=bg]
    sc=[c for c in range(w) if len({g[r][c] for r in range(h)})==1 and g[0][c]!=bg]
    sv = g[sr[0]][0] if sr else g[0][sc[0]]
    cells=[(r,c,g[r][c]) for r in range(h) for c in range(w) if g[r][c]!=bg and g[r][c]!=sv]
    out=[[bg]*w for _ in range(h)]
    if sr:                     # horizontal separator
        idx=sr[0]; rs=sorted(r for r,c,v in cells)
        if rs[-1]<idx:         # shape above separator -> slides DOWN to touch
            tgt, far_edge, sign = idx-1, idx-1, -1
        else:                   # shape below -> slides UP
            tgt, far_edge, sign = idx+1, idx+1, 1
        near = rs[-1] if rs[-1]<idx else rs[0]
        d = tgt-near
        for r,c,v in cells: out[r+d][c]=v
        far = rs[-1]+d if rs[-1]<idx else rs[0]+d   # far edge from separator
        r8 = far - 1 if rs[-1]<idx else far + 1     # one step beyond far edge, away from sep
        for c in range(w): out[r8][c]=8
    else:                      # vertical separator
        idx=sc[0]; cs=sorted(c for r,c,v in cells)
        if cs[-1]<idx:         # shape left -> slides RIGHT to touch
            tgt, far_edge, sign = idx-1, idx-1, 1
        else:                   # shape right -> slides LEFT
            tgt, far_edge, sign = idx+1, idx+1, -1
        near = cs[-1] if cs[-1]<idx else cs[0]
        d = tgt-near
        for r,c,v in cells: out[r][c+d]=v
        fc = cs[-1]+d if cs[-1]<idx else cs[0]+d    # far edge from separator
        c8 = fc - 1 if cs[-1]<idx else fc + 1       # one step beyond far edge, away from sep
        for r in range(h): out[r][c8]=8
    return out

for k in ['Demo pair 1','Demo pair 2','Demo pair 3','Demo pair 4']:
    print(k, f(G[k+' input'])==G[k+' output'])
